name: Windmill
description: Developer platform for turning scripts into workflows, APIs, and scheduled jobs.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DATABASE_URL: "postgres://windmill:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/windmill?sslmode=disable"
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/worker-logs:/tmp/windmill/logs
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: windmill
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: windmill
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-worker:
    image: ghcr.io/windmill-labs/windmill:main
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-worker
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: "postgres://windmill:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/windmill?sslmode=disable"
      MODE: worker
